review: I like how it looks: each stage has its own colour, and spikes, saws and lasers are easy to read. But First Steps is not a gentle start. 29 of 100 ghosts died there, and the mid player stood beside one spike patch for about six seconds. Saw Mill comes too early and feels mean, with small saws floating at jump height. Ferry Lines and Crumble Bridge were my favourites, because a fall there is clearly my own mistake. Laser Gate is clear, but the dim dotted lasers are hard to see. Gauntlet mixes everything and killed even the best player, so I would probably quit there.
best: Ferry Lines and Crumble Bridge are clean, readable stages where a death is my own fault.
worst: Saw Mill is too hard for stage 3, and First Steps already kills almost a third of players.
